sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Receivables vs. Revenue Growth: Days sales outstanding moved +11 days over 5 years while revenue compounded 57.1%. Receivables are growing faster than sales, which can flatter revenue recognition and must be watched.
Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 13.5 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 13.5 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +32.0% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.

Payout Ratio Sustainability: Dividends absorbed 72% of earnings against free cash flow of 104% of net profit. The payout is above what the business generates, so it depends on cash reserves or borrowing.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 1 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 218 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -4.6% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 5 hard red flags and 2 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 70/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
